svg.title: PrefetchTrainPipelineSparseDist: one steady-state progress()
svg.desc: Host submission order, not a measured timeline. Backend cache dependencies still apply. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. Entry: i has post-prefetch state; i+1 has an outstanding split request. Training stream joins prefetch(i); zero_grad already submitted enqueue_batch(i+2): nonblocking device copy wait_sparse_data_dist(i+1): consume split request D2 / V2 host reads and payload launches inside this call are expanded below. i+1: read received split sizes on the host _safe_tolist_2d(output_tensor): D2H + current-stream sync; receive sizes are needed before payload allocation. i+1: read sent splits for overflow validation The pinned _wait_impl also calls _safe_tolist_2d(input_tensor): another D2H / stream sync, before payload launch. i+1: stage recat permutation on CUDA Payload awaitable construction prepares the GPU permutation from host metadata. i+1: launch lengths and ID values AllToAll Construct tensors awaitables from host receive sizes; two separate payload collectives for the baseline KJT. Forward of batch i; payload of i+1 can overlap PrefetchPipelinedForward consumes ready input / context for i Lookup(i), output AllToAll(i), downstream forward(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. Clear consumed post-prefetch dictionaries for i After forward returns; before backward is submitted _prefetch(i+1): second wait / reconstruct KJT on data_dist Consume payload and recat the received KJT; the following D3 read is inside this second wait. i+1: dist_init -> sync -> length_per_key Fixed-stride reconstructed KJT, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + current-stream sync before input is returned. Prefetch stream waits for data_dist; record_stream module.prefetch(i+1); save ready input + context backward(i), reverse embedding AllToAll(i), optimizer(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. Source allows concurrent submission; actual prefetch/backward overlap is backend-dependent. Prepare the following iteration data_dist waits for the copy of i+2 start_sparse_data_dist(i+2): input_dist / bucketize Prepare the row-owner input and split metadata. i+2: dist_splits -> length_per_key -> _safe_tolist Uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths: reduce on GPU, copy to CPU, synchronize the current stream. i+2: stage splits / stride as CUDA tensors KJTAllToAllForward returns metadata; compatible split collectives launch after fusion. i+2: validate each staged split tensor Pinned-version check: _safe_tolist(t) for each CUDA split tensor, before fused AllToAll; repeated D2H / stream sync. i+2: launch fused split-size AllToAll Prepared split metadata is fused by process group before the collective launch. dequeue i; next forward will join prefetch(i+1)

svg.text: D1 send sizes / D2 receive sizes / D3 reconstructed KJT metadata match the row-wise input-distribution diagram.
V1 and V2 are extra validation readbacks in the pinned version; V1 repeats for each staged split tensor.
Labels identify read sites, not fixed stall counts. Cached / empty paths can skip D1 or D3; stream waits alone do not imply a host read.
